list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation and tracked by Exophase and PSNProfiles (reported 18 November 2026). Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; every guide below is written for this atlas, in its own words, and cites its sources.

roadmap.title: Story first, missable-proof
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1 to 5 in order and finish every story mission. That earns all 12 story trophies (11 bronze, 1 gold) by itself. Do the Chapter 1 meditation the first time it is offered: Positive Mental Attitude is the list's one missable trophy, because its first meditation sits inside Chapter 1. Take the side-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) as they open, so their final missions land before the credits.

roadmap.title: Leonida's people
roadmap.text: After the story, sweep the stranger strands: 8 mission strands for strangers across the state earn Strangers & Freaks. Mop up any side-character final you skipped, then do the two partner trophies while Lucia and Jason are together in free roam: lose a 4-star wanted level together, and rob 3 shops back to back without dropping the wanted level.

roadmap.title: Activities and skills
roadmap.text: Work the repeatable activities in any order: gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, land 250 stunts, win 20 different races and a Top Fun drone race at all 14 spots, beat Cal at fishing, finish one arcade game, bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley, and clear 50 challenges. Keep an eye on the in-game challenge list so nothing on it is left half done.

roadmap.title: Collectibles, money and 100%
roadmap.text: Finish the long counts last, when the whole map is open: 3 card sets, WAiNK at 100 spots, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas explored, all 8 garage properties bought, 10 vehicles registered to Scooter Bros, $250,000 of marked bills laundered and $100,000 spent in shops. Then open the 100% completion checklist and close its last tasks: A Long Road (gold) unlocks, and the Platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops with it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is no separate task here: the Platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below, not a trophy to chase directly. The last one most players earn is A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, so the Platinum arrives right after the final checklist task is closed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so this trophy lands in the opening hour with no preparation and no way to miss it. If you are replaying, it is the mission the story starts with, not a side activity.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter closes, so just keep following the story markers. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the meditation the game offers there: the trophy Positive Mental Attitude has its first meditation spot in this chapter, and it is the list's one missable risk.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks automatically when the chapter ends, so there is nothing extra to hunt for. Keep playing the story in order and it pops at the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy is the chapter's closing reward, so follow the story missions until the chapter wraps up. By now the map is opening up, but the chapter trophy itself needs no detour into side content.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. It pops when the chapter closes, the same as the earlier chapter trophies. If a side-character strand is still open, take it before the finale: their final missions are easier to reach while the story is still running.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. This is the list's second gold trophy and it marks the end of the main plot, so it comes after Chapter 4 and every mission that leads into the finale. Once it pops, the whole map stays open for the cleanup phases of the roadmap.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run through to its end. It is one of the named story missions, so it unlocks as the plot reaches it. No special approach is needed: finish the mission's objectives and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist through to its end. Heist missions in this series tend to have a setup phase first, so follow the mission chain until the heist itself runs and completes. The trophy pops at the mission's end screen.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play through to its end. It is a named story mission, so it arrives in the normal flow of the plot. Finish its objectives and the trophy unlocks with the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Headliners through to its end. The mission's name is the clue: it is a headline set piece in the story, so expect a longer mission and follow its objectives to the end. The trophy pops when it completes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown through to its end. VCIA is Vice City International Airport, on the south-west side of the city, and the mission takes the fight there. Finish the takedown's objectives and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory through to its end. The operation name points to a military-style set piece, so expect heavy combat and follow the mission's objectives step by step. The trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion checklist, which opens after the story. The checklist is a set of tasks across the whole game — story missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries — reported as a 35-task list. Work the roadmap phases in order and check the in-game checklist after each phase, so the last few percent are a short list of named tasks instead of a blind hunt.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, near misses, long air time and the game's other stunt types all count toward the total. The fastest way is to chain them in free roam after the story, using ramps and jumps you already know, rather than hunting one perfect spot. The in-game stats screen tracks the running count, so check it between sessions and stop grinding the moment it hits 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the game's 9 activity types. The types are the things marked on the map as things to do — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, drone racing, meditation and the rest. You only need one try of each, not a win, so walk into each activity, start it once, and move on. Do this early and the rest of the activity trophies build on the same visits.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 separate challenges, so treat it as a checklist, not one hard test: clear them in batches and replay only the ones that fall short of gold. Use the range's own scoring feedback — a near-gold run tells you which shots cost time — and pick weapons you are accurate with rather than the strongest ones.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 drone race locations. Each location is its own race, so you need 14 wins in 14 different places, not 14 wins anywhere. Learn one course at a time, keep the drone low through the gates, and tick each location off on the map as you win it so no spot is left behind.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Replays of the same race do not count twice, so spread your wins across the map: street races, off-road races and the other race types each add their own entries. Pick a fast, stable car for each surface and learn the first corner of each course, since most races are decided there.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the rival angler, so look for the fishing challenge marker on the water — piers, the Leonida Keys and the Grassrivers are the natural fishing country — and take the challenge when it is offered. Watch the line tension the way the game's fishing tutorial teaches it, reel in steadily, and outscore Cal across the challenge's rounds.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Arcades sit in Vice City's entertainment spots, so walk into one, pick any cabinet and play it through to its end screen. You do not need a high score or a win against anyone: reaching the end of a single game is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Andy is one of the five side characters with their own strand, so take his missions whenever his marker appears and keep going until his last one completes. Do it while the story is still running if you can: side strands are easiest to reach before the finale.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Kenton is one of the five side characters with their own strand, so follow his missions to their end. The trophy's name is a hint at the water: expect boats in his strand and take his missions as they appear.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Billy is one of the five side characters with their own strand, so take his missions whenever his marker appears. The lone rider name points to solo bike work, so expect to ride alone through his strand's final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers show up as question-mark encounters on the map, scattered from Vice City to the far counties, and each one has a short strand of missions rather than a single job. Take every stranger marker you pass, finish each strand to its end, and keep a note of which ones are done: 8 finished strands is the count, not 8 single missions.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Randy is one of the five side characters with their own strand, so follow his missions until his last one completes. His strand runs on supply runs, so expect driving and delivery work on the way to the finale.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Tyrone is one of the five side characters with their own strand, so take his missions as they appear and keep going to his last one. Do the strand before the story finale if you can, while his marker is easy to reach.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the list's one missable trophy: the first meditation is a session with Lucia in Chapter 1, and guides flag it as the one spot that can be missed if you walk past it. So in Chapter 1, take the meditation the moment the game offers it, then visit the other 17 spots in free roam afterwards. Meditation spots sit at viewpoints and quiet places around the state, so check the map for them as you explore each region.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunt sends you after one specific animal, not just any wildlife, so take his strand and follow its tracking clues to the animal's territory. The wild country is the Grassrivers and the Mount Kalaga area, so bring a scoped rifle, move quietly, and take the shot only when the animal is clearly the one Bret named.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses and out-of-the-way spots — and each set needs every card in it, so a set only counts when its last card is found. Pick the three shortest sets first, sweep one region at a time, and use the in-game collection screen to see which cards each set is still missing.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. Each spot only counts once, so the job is coverage: work region by region and let the map's own markers show which spots are still unused. Pair this with the exploration trophy, since both reward visiting new places, and the count climbs fastest while you are already travelling for other trophies.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges are the small tasks the game tracks on the side — driving feats, combat feats, exploration feats — and they pile up naturally while you play. Open the challenge list, pick off the ones closest to done first, and let the long grinds (stunts, races, collectibles) finish the rest on their own.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. Get the four stars with your partner in the car — cause chaos until the fourth star appears — then break line of sight, switch cars or hide until the stars blink out and the heat is gone. Do it in free roam after the story, when both characters are free to roam together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level. The trick is the route: pick three shops close together on one street, hit each one fast, and keep at least one wanted star alive between robberies by staying visible to the police without getting caught. If the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start again from shop one.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting into a vehicle you have never driven counts as a discovery, so the job is variety: try everything you pass — cars, bikes, boats, trucks and the odd one out — instead of sticking to one favourite. Car parks, the port and the airport are dense with new models, and the in-game vehicle list shows how many are still undiscovered.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd — a gang shootout or a police response — then trigger Combat Focus only when five or more enemies are in front of you and in range. Pick them off quickly before the focus runs out; if the count falls short, the trophy simply does not pop and you try again in the next big fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA, Vice City International Airport. Get onto the airfield — through the gates or over a fence — grab a plane and take off from a runway without a flight plan, or simply drive off the runway at speed. The airport sits south-west of Vice City, and any aircraft on the tarmac will do.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the military tanks that roll in at the highest wanted levels. Push your wanted level to the top in free roam until a Rhino appears, then take it on: sticky explosives and heavy weapons from cover work better than a head-on fight. You only need to handle the tanks the game throws at you, so survive the encounter and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Go in quiet: move when the clerk and any guard look away, take the goods without smashing a display in view, and leave before the alarm trips. If anyone spots you or the alarm sounds, leave and try another store — the trophy needs a fully clean run.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each bank is its own job: get in, open the vault, grab the cash and get out before the police close in. Plan the getaway first — a fast car parked close by, facing the road — and treat each vault as a separate run, since the count only rises when you escape cleanly.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city, so watch the roads until one passes, force it to stop, break into the back and take the cash. Then lose the wanted level that follows — the escape is part of the trophy, so do not stop running until the stars are gone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. An area counts once you have driven or walked through it, so the job is a road trip: cover every county — Vice City and Vice-Dale, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga — and watch the in-game map fill in. The last few areas are usually the small ones on the edges, so check the map for blank patches when the count stalls.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs hold their own rackets around Leonida, so find one operation per gang, hit it and get out. Keep a list of which gangs you have done: the trophy needs all nine, and the last gang is easy to forget when eight are already ticked off.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach — the strip along Vice City's eastern shore — order a cocktail and drink it while the view is the sea. It is a quiet moment trophy, so do it when you are passing the beach anyway and the trophy pops without a fight.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car into a showroom, then floor it straight back out through the glass front — the big, loud exit is the whole point. Pick a showroom with a wide glass front, line the car up before you go in, and expect a wanted level on the way out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, start a game of bowling and play it through — the follow-through is the bowling itself, so finish the game rather than quitting halfway. It is a nod to the series' old bowling nights, and one full game is all it takes.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal. This one is tied to Lucia and Jason's partnership reaching a wide audience — the in-game social side of their story — so it pops from story and social play rather than from a single task. Keep playing the partnership content as it comes and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices across the game until the count reaches 500. The game tracks the choices you make — in missions, in conversations and in free-roam decisions — and the trophy pops when the tally hits 500. There is nothing to aim at: just play the whole game, take the dialogue and mission choices as they come, and the count climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try at something you just failed. The trophy is about the retry itself: fail an attempt — a mission, a challenge, a stunt — and then succeed at the very next try. It pops naturally during a normal playthrough, since everyone fails something eventually; if it has not popped by the end, pick a short challenge, fail it once on purpose and pass it right after.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida. This is the list's mystery trophy: it pops when you stumble on one of the game's odd events — the kind of unexplained sighting the series hides in the wild places. Explore the remote corners of the map at night, especially around Mount Kalaga and the Grassrivers, and keep your eyes open for anything that does not belong.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: hit a pedestrian with a melee swing from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing the melee weapon as you pass, and the trophy pops when they go down. Do it on a quiet street so the police do not turn a silly trophy into a chase.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies, and your contacts turn them into clean money a cut at a time. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and the total adds up across the whole game — the in-game stats track the laundered amount, so check it whenever you visit a contact.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Every dollar in every shop counts — clothes, weapons, food, car mods — so just buy what you need as you play and the total climbs. If it is the last trophy standing, the fastest way to close it is car modifications, which eat money quickly, or a shopping run through the expensive clothes stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are the properties that store your vehicles, and they go up for sale around the map as you progress. Buy each one when you can afford it — they double as safe parking for the cars you need for the vehicle trophies — and the trophy pops when the eighth deed is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app and register it — each new registration counts once. Work through ten different vehicles you already own or find on the street, and the trophy pops at the tenth registration.
